fusions.name: Gentle Pressure
fusions.desc: Spits a ball of water that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Undertow Draw
fusions.desc: Opens an undertow 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Easy Current
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Mend
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they spend at once and you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
